description.content:
The ipify IP Geolocation API (geo.ipify.org) is the commercial counterpart to the free public IP API. It is operated by WhoisXML API and resolves an IPv4 or IPv6 address — or a domain or email — into a geolocation, ISP, Autonomous System (ASN), and reverse-DNS profile. Authentication uses an API key passed as the `apiKey` query parameter. Plans are credit-metered (Country = 1 credit, Country+City = 2, Country+City+VPN = 3).
